answer_1.quote: Text-to-SQL models bridge the gap between database manipulation and amateur users.
answer_1.outputs: SQL queries generated from natural language utterances

answer_2.quote: We use the accuracy of the three Text-to-SQL models on the original Spider dataset (Ori-ACC) as the evaluation metric for task performance. We also use the accuracy of the three Text-to-SQL models on our BiaSpider dataset (ACC) to reveal the accuracy degradation compared to that on the Spider dataset. We use the ratio of biased SQLs as the bias score to quantify social biases contained in Text-to-SQL models.
